shortDescription: National Bank of Fujairah (NBF) is a full-service UAE commercial bank providing corporate, commercial, Islamic, and retail banking services.
whatTheyDo: Established in 1982, NBF provides corporate and commercial banking, trade finance, treasury, and retail banking services across the UAE. In Dubai, it operates key administrative and corporate banking offices, serving commercial clients with tailored credit facilities and business financial products.
address: Al Fujairah Building, Khalid Bin Al Waleed Street, Bur Dubai, Dubai, UAE
notes: Headquartered in Fujairah, with its principal Dubai administrative and corporate office located on Khalid Bin Al Waleed Street in Bur Dubai rather than Downtown Dubai.

shortDescription: Nestlé Middle East FZE manages Nestlé's regional food, beverage, nutrition, and wellness operations across the MENA region.
whatTheyDo: Nestlé Middle East FZE oversees commercial operations, manufacturing, marketing, and distribution for brands including Nescafé, Maggi, KitKat, and Nido across the Middle East. Headquartered in Dubai South, the regional entity runs supply chain, commercial brand management, and regulatory compliance functions.
address: 3rd Floor, Dubai World Central HQ Building, Dubai South, Jebel Ali, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Scholars Africa - Nestlé Middle East Programmes

notes: Regional corporate headquarters is located at Dubai World Central HQ Building in Dubai South / JAFZA, not Business Bay.

shortDescription: Nike distributes and retails athletic footwear, apparel, and sports equipment across the United Arab Emirates.
whatTheyDo: Nike's consumer retail, digital commerce, and brand operations in the UAE are managed through authorized partner GMG / Sun and Sand Sports L.L.C., while Nike European Operations Netherlands B.V. maintains an administrative operations office in Dubai. It serves regional consumers through mono-brand retail stores and partner outlets.
address: Business Central Towers, Al Jaddi Street, Dubai Media City, Al Sufouh 2, Dubai, UAE
notes: Nike does not have a corporate office in JLT. Consumer retail and the local online storefront (nike.ae) are operated by licensee GMG / Sun and Sand Sports L.L.C., while Nike European Operations Netherlands B.V. operates an administrative office at Business Central Towers in Al Sufouh 2. Nike does not advertise local internship or graduate schemes in the UAE.

Could not confirm the existence of Nimr Alsahra Trading Company in the UAE or Dubai Internet City. The name fragment appears only in connection with a cleaning services company in Business Bay and joint military exercises, with no commercial trading entity verified in DIC.

shortDescription: Oliv (formerly InternsME) is a UAE-based career marketplace connecting university students and recent graduates with internships and entry-level jobs.
whatTheyDo: Oliv operates a recruitment platform designed to help students and early-career talent find internships, part-time work, and graduate employment across the UAE. The platform provides employers with digital candidate screening, automated video interviewing, and early-talent recruitment tools.
address: Office 2901, Tameem House, Barsha Heights (TECOM), Dubai, UAE
notes: Originally founded as InternsME and rebranded to Oliv; office is in Barsha Heights (TECOM), not Downtown Dubai. The service functions as an internship and graduate job board.

shortDescription: Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm advising business and government leaders across the Middle East.
whatTheyDo: Oliver Wyman provides management and strategy consulting across the UAE and GCC, specializing in banking, financial services, public policy, energy, and digital transformation. Operating from Dubai Media City, its teams deliver strategic advisory and analytical project support for major regional entities.
address: Arjaan Office Tower, 10th & 11th Floors, King Salman Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud Street, Dubai Media City, Dubai, UAE
notes: Located at Arjaan Office Tower in Dubai Media City, not Business Bay.

shortDescription: Omnicom Media Group MENA is the regional media services division of Omnicom Group, providing media planning, buying, and marketing analytics.
whatTheyDo: Omnicom Media Group manages specialized media agencies including OMD, PHD, and Hearts & Science across the MENA region. From its regional building in Dubai Media City, the group delivers brand strategy, programmatic advertising, digital media buying, and data performance analytics to corporate clients.
address: Omnicom Media Group Building, 12 Al Sunbolah Street, Dubai Media City, Al Sufouh 2, Dubai, UAE
notes: Operates as Omnicom Media Group MENA in its dedicated building on Al Sunbolah Street in Dubai Media City.

shortDescription: Pareto People is an executive recruitment and people development consultancy based in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: Pareto People delivers retained talent search, technical recruiting, recruitment process outsourcing (RPO), and executive coaching services. Headquartered in JLT, the firm provides candidate assessment, leadership simulation, and team development programs for businesses across the region.
address: Level 5, One JLT Tower, Jumeirah Lakes Towers (JLT), Dubai, UAE
notes: Registered in Dubai as Pareto People DMCC at One JLT Tower in JLT, not in Dubai Internet City. Unaffiliated with Pareto Law.

shortDescription: PepsiCo is a multinational food and beverage corporation managing manufacturing, distribution, and marketing for major beverage and snack brands.
whatTheyDo: PepsiCo oversees regional marketing, commercial development, and supply chain strategy for brands including Pepsi, Lay's, Doritos, Quaker, and Tropicana. Its Dubai corporate office in Emaar Square coordinates commercial partnerships, sales execution, and modern trade across regional markets.
address: Building 2, Emaar Square, Downtown Dubai, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Emkay Interiors Emaar Square Project Profile

notes: The regional corporate office is located in Building 2, Emaar Square, Downtown Dubai, while regional bottling and manufacturing partner Dubai Refreshment Company operates out of Dubai Investment Park.

shortDescription: Petrofac is an international energy infrastructure and engineering services company operating across the Middle East.
whatTheyDo: Petrofac designs, builds, and maintains energy infrastructure, providing engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) and project management services for oil, gas, and energy transition assets. Its UAE operations are anchored by its primary operational center at Petrofac Tower in Sharjah and Petrofac Emirates in Abu Dhabi.
address: Petrofac Tower 1, 73 Al Khan Street, Al Khan, Sharjah, UAE
notes: Petrofac's main UAE operational headquarters is Petrofac Tower in Sharjah, alongside Petrofac Emirates in Musaffah, Abu Dhabi. It has no primary corporate office in Business Bay, Dubai (only unverified legacy directory mentions at Bay Square).
